subject: integration
name: Brave Search
summary: A pointer to Brave Search, a Web2 search service. Text typed in the address bar opens https://search.brave.com/search?q=<text> in the tab, so Brave's own servers and code answer and see the text and the connection's IP address; nothing checks the results. It has no suggestion address, so nothing leaves before Enter. Level 1, not 2: what it shows is Brave's pages, not content Orivon pins. Judged here by its publisher.
